name: Blazing Memory Boost!
main_effect:
[Main] Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. You may add 2 cards with the [Blue Flare] trait among them to your hand, and play 1 [Kiriha Aonuma] among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・Gain 2 memory.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
